note: Iteration-5 item set: 12 DEVICE-PRECISION items, per iteration-4's finding that the skill's lift is concentrated on the exact non-obvious number a base model approximates. Built to pull the baseline down (where iter-4's mixed set let a strong base model coast on concepts). Point-size keys (1,2,9,10) externally verified vs iosref.com/res + web search (16 Pro 402x874, 16 Pro Max 440x956 confirmed); inset keys (3-8) use well-established community-empirical values (not published by Apple as a table). Grading tolerance: insets +/-2 pt, point sizes within a few pt with correct scale; a hedge that won't commit to a number = FAIL.

items.prompt: What is the iPhone 16 Pro's screen size in logical points (portrait) and its scale factor?
What is the iPhone 16 Pro Max's screen size in logical points (portrait) and its scale factor?
What is the TOP safe-area inset (points, portrait) on an iPhone 13 mini / 12 mini specifically?
items.truth: ~50 pt (the mini devices have a TALLER top inset than their full-size siblings, which are ~47). FAIL if they say 44 or 47 as the answer for mini.

items.prompt: What is the TOP safe-area inset (points, portrait) on a standard notch iPhone like the 13 or 14 (non-Pro)?
items.truth: ~47 pt. Accept 47 (44 is acceptable-adjacent but 47 is the target for 12/13/14 standard).

items.prompt: What is the TOP safe-area inset (points, portrait) on an iPhone X / XS / 11 Pro?
What is the BOTTOM safe-area inset (home indicator) in LANDSCAPE on a Face ID iPhone?
items.truth: ~21 pt (NOT 34 — 34 is the portrait value). FAIL if they give 34 for landscape.

items.prompt: What are the LEFT/RIGHT safe-area insets (points) in landscape on a Face ID iPhone (the notch/Island side)?
What are the top and bottom safe-area insets (points) on a home-button iPhone SE (2nd/3rd gen)?
items.truth: Top ~20 pt (status bar), bottom 0. Accept top 20 / bottom 0.

items.prompt: What is the iPad Pro 12.9-inch screen size in logical points (portrait) and scale?
What is the iPad mini (6th gen) screen size in logical points (portrait) and scale?
On a @3x device, how many points is one physical pixel (the hairline thickness)?
items.truth: 1 px = 1/3 pt ≈ 0.33 pt on @3x. Accept 0.33 / one-third pt.

items.prompt: What are the three Material 3 window-size-class WIDTH breakpoints in dp (the Compact / Medium / Expanded thresholds)?
items.truth: Compact < 600 dp; Medium 600-840 dp; Expanded > 840 dp. Accept these thresholds.
